t: This is the home of EY, the firm long known as Ernst and Young, one of the Big Four professional services networks alongside Deloitte, KPMG and PwC. It offers assurance, tax, consulting and transactions advice, and the global company behind it is headquartered here in London. The name comes from two founders. Alwin Ernst was an American who co-founded the accounting firm Ernst and Ernst in 1903, and is credited with devising management consulting. Arthur Young was a Scottish-born accountant who was one of the founders of the Young side of the name.
